repo:cloud#2 · os-zhuang · session_01QUs3BuhJziidmx7KHut5GG

Report, 2026-11-03T04:49Z: card B of cloud#3487 D is implemented in #29778 (ready for review, every check green on `ebe16a4c`).

- The environment list offers only "Set up your production environment". Once the org owns its production environment, the `create_environment` action is withheld: no "Add development environment", no plan-locked "Development environments · Team plan and up" mark, no dialog, no POST.
- `entitlementDialogFromError` maps `PRODUCTION_ENV_LIMIT` only. `DEV_ENV_PLAN_LOCKED`, `DEV_ENV_LIMIT` and `DEV_ENV_RETIRED` take the ordinary error path, showing the server's own message.
- Removed from all ten locale bundles: `planTier.teamAndUp`, `environment.addDevelopment`, `environment.developmentLocked`, `environment.entitlement.{planLockedTitle, planLockedBody, limitTitle, limitBody, limitBodyWithCount, freePlan, namedPlan, upgradeCta}`. The ADR-0060 allowlist shrinks to match.
- Tests: nine entitlement states × en/zh render no development door; the retired codes open no dialog; the production path pins are unchanged.
- Changeset: `@object-ui/app-shell` + `@object-ui/i18n` patch, `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`.

The PR says `Part of #29770`, not `Closes`, because the executing branch is a project-thread branch. The closing-target guard cannot read a claim on it. **Close this card by hand when #29778 lands.**

One note for cloud card A: in the no-signal state (summary and rows both unreadable), an org that already owns its environment still sees the metadata-labelled create button. Its POST then shows whichever code cloud returns for a typeless create once production exists.
